targetQuery.reason: No documented, externally reachable, anonymous parcel feature endpoint was found; the apparent official Geoportail link is a placeholder and the research GeoServer is localhost. No guessed query, authentication route or unrelated administrative layer was probed.

remainingUncertainty: The cadastre.gouv.cd host could not be resolved from this environment; government and e-Foncier systems may hold cadastral records behind an unavailable or access-controlled service. The existence of local records or the Gombe pilot does not establish anonymous public access at the WUP coordinate.
nextStep: If the official cadastre portal becomes reachable or the Geoportail link is published, inspect its documented public service and run one bounded target query for the WUP coordinate before reconsidering the source.
